callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.from_proj_dir
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is a string path to an existing project root directory with source files.
callees.post_condition: Returns a CodeGraphExtractor instance initialized with the project's code graph index if the index exists and is valid; returns None or a falsy value if initialization fails.

callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.get_call_edges
callees.pre_condition: The receiver is a valid, initialized CodeGraphExtractor instance; language_key is a string identifying a supported language.
callees.post_condition: Returns a dict mapping each caller FQN (str) to a set of callee FQNs (set[str]) for all call edges discovered in source files matching the given language key. Both keys and values use canonicalized fully-qualified names with '::' as the separator.
